findings.claim: pure function: no fs, no store writes, no network
findings.evidence: File imports only node:path, RunnerConfigError (src/runner/dispatch/config.mjs), operationsForStage (src/state/workflow-stage-graphs.mjs). No fs/http/store-write call in the file. operationsForStage/bundleForStage/resolveWorkflow (workflow-stage-graphs.mjs lines 662-686, 635-647, 576-580) are pure in-memory lookups against the DOMAINS table; the module's own fs reads (loadDomainsFromDisk, line 367) run once at module-load time, not per call.
findings.note: Documented nuance, not a mismatch: purity of enrichAndValidateContract's own call behavior holds even though a statically-imported dependency does one-time load-time fs reads.

findings.claim: never selects executor/provider/tier or touches Work lifecycle; compileDispatchPlan remains sole execution chooser
findings.evidence: No call to compileDispatchPlan or any dispatch/executor-selection function; no Work-mutation import (no store.mjs/work.mjs write call). Only output beyond the enriched contract is `policy` from mergeHarnessPolicy(matchedOp.policy, undefined) -- the matched operation's own statically declared policy, forwarded as a separate top-level field, matching the ADR's allowed 'policy hints' carve-out distinct from live executor/tier selection. Code comment states explicitly this module never sets an executor id.

findings.claim: fail-closed reject when contract.supports is not a legal operation for the Work's current stage
findings.evidence: Lines 113-121: stageOps = operationsForStage(domain, work.stage, {kind: resolvedWorkflow}); matchedOp = stageOps.find(o => o.id === contract.supports); if (!matchedOp) fail(...) throws RunnerConfigError. Hard reject, no silent fallback.

findings.claim: only appends to (never replaces) contextRefs/constraints/expectedOutputs already supplied by the caller
findings.evidence: contextRefs (lines 127-132), constraints (lines 137-140), expectedOutputs (lines 146-149) all copy the caller's existing array first, then conditionally push new entries de-duplicated by exact string match. No wholesale overwrite of any of the three fields.
